title: Harry Potter Jada Nano Metalfigs Diecast 1.5" Hermione Granger
descriptionText: The Harry Potter Jada Nano Metalfigs Diecast 1.5" Hermione Granger is a collectible action figure from the Harry Potter franchise. Made of die-cast material, this original licensed reproduction by Jada Toys features Hermione Granger from the movie Harry Potter and the Chamber of Secrets. Standing at 1.5 inches tall, this action figure is a perfect addition to any Harry Potter fan's collection, capturing the essence of the beloved character in intricate detail.
